body:
Hysmidaemon
CR 9

This ferocious werewolf-like daemon is covered in shaggy fur and carries a burning sword.

XP 6,400
NE Medium outsider (daemon, evil, extraplanar)
Init +4; Senses darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +23

DEFENSE

AC 23, touch 14, flat-footed 19 (+4 Dex, +9 natural)
hp +114 (11d10+54)
Fort +12, Ref +10, Will +5; +2 racial bonus vs. spells and spell-like abilities and +4 racial bonus against fear effects
DR 10/law; Immune acid, death effects, disease and poison; Resist cold 10, electricity 10, fire 10; SR 20

OFFENSE

Speed 40 ft.
Melee longsword +15/+10 (1d8+9)
Ranged javelin +13/+8 (1d6+6)
Spell-Like Abilities (CL 12; Charisma-based)

3/day—burning hands (DC 13)
1/day—rage, shield of faith, summon (level 4; 1 cacodaemon 100%)

STATISTICS

Str 22, Dex 18, Con 23, Int 10, Wis 14, Cha 14
Base Atk +9; CMB +15; CMD 29
Feats Athletic, Diehard, Endurance, Run, Vital Strike
Skills Bluff +13, Climb +12, Intimidate +13, Knowledge (planes) +11, Perception +23, Sense Motive +15, Spellcraft +11, Stealth +11, Survival +15; Racial Modifiers +8 Perception
Languages Abyssal, Draconic, Infernal, telepathy 100 ft.

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Arcane Touch (Su)

All weapon attacks made by a Hysmidaemon are considered to be magic for the purpose of overcoming damage reduction.

Furious Assault (Ex)

Hysmidaemon add one and a half times their Strength modifier when wielding a one-handed melee weapon in one hand.

Superheat Metal (Su)

A Hysmidaemon can use a swift action to superheat a held metal item for 1 round. If a Hysmidaemon hits a creature with a metal weapon that has been superheated, it deals an additional 1d4 fire damage.

ECOLOGY

Environment any (Hades or the Void)
Organization solitary, pair, or gang (3-10)
Treasure standard

The Hysmidaemon embody the chaotic and destructive forces unleashed upon mortal realms during times of bloodshed and violence. Standing almost seven feet tall, their muscular frames are covered with dark, shaggy fur. Their heads resemble carnivorous beasts such as wolves and lions.

The Hysmidaemon are the offspring of Eris and the twisted essence of warfare itself. These fiends embody the very essence of battle and conflict.

Some tales claim the Hysmidaemon are the personifications of the intense rage and brutality witnessed on the battlefield, while others describe them as vengeful spirits invoked by warriors seeking divine assistance in their quest for victory.

The Hysmidaemon are relentless adversaries, driven by an insatiable thirst for violence and chaos.

Armed with longswords and javelins, they move with unnatural speed and strike with brutal precision.

Warriors entreat these fiends, seeking their dark blessings and the raw power of their combat prowess. In rituals dedicated to Ares, cultists call upon the Hysmidaemons’ frenzied spirits to empower soldiers on the battlefield. Those who witness the wrath of the Hysmidaemon experience the very fabric of war itself.
